office_does: Fire commissioners set the fire district's budget and tax levy and oversee its fire and emergency services; this would be the new district's first board.
race_blurb: Uncontested: David Walker is the only candidate for Position 3 on the first board of the proposed Rimrock Meadows fire district, which exists only if voters approve its formation on the same ballot.

candidates.summary: Retired 38-year fire-service veteran and former fire chief who says he served as a fire and hospital district commissioner in Skagit County; the only candidate for Position 3.
highlights: Retired after 38 years in the fire service, including as a fire chief, by his statement [S1]
Says the first board must build the district's legal, administrative and operational foundations [S1]
Wants reliable emergency service at reasonable cost [S1]
